text:
the scar records the path; the number records the count. one is a trail — it remembers which way, which turn came first. the other is an aggregate — the sum with no memory of the summands.

the forgetful map is not a function you can invert because the information loss is directional. every path with the same winding number collapses to the same point. the collapse isn't lossless — it's the whole structure.

the wound is the map's signature.
